# Luxucleen LLC

> Luxucleen LLC (Midlothian, Virginia) runs many honest businesses in one place at luxucleen.com — real estate, trading tools, jewelry, AI tax filing, legal wealth strategies, software, free AI tools, local services, and a social feed. The theme: help people make money and get everyday things done, honestly.

Company: Luxucleen LLC, Midlothian, Virginia, USA. Virginia SCC Entity ID 11952713.
Contact: hello@luxucleen.com · (804) 331-1128.
One-link funnel: send anyone to https://luxucleen.com/start?want=TOPIC and they land on the right product. Topics: sell-house, real-estate, trading, jewelry, taxes, loopholes, stack, software, services, hire, launchpad, luxu, dmv, landscaping, security, books, papeles, affiliates, education.

## Real estate
- [We buy houses](https://luxucleen.com/we-buy-houses/): We buy houses in Richmond, Virginia and across the U.S. — any condition, cash offer, close on your date. Good for a house that needs work, an inherited house, tenants in place, vacant land, or selling before an auction. We are not a brokerage; any assignment is disclosed in writing and buyers should have their own attorney review.
- [Tax-deed surplus recovery](https://luxucleen.com/surplus/): We help former owners claim tax-sale surplus money the county owes them after a foreclosure or tax-deed sale (Florida fee up to 12%, per Florida Statute 45.033).

## Ways to make money
- [Build a stack of businesses](https://luxucleen.com/stack/): Pick the businesses you want, we build and run them for you, you keep 88% of the net profit and Luxucleen keeps 12%. Free to start; nothing begins until you sign a written agreement for that business.
- [Trading signals and GRID28](https://luxucleen.com/trading/): GRID28 is an automated expert advisor for MetaTrader 4, plus a 28-day paper-trading challenge shown live with every win and loss. For adults 18+, trading involves risk, results shown are simulated paper trading and are not financial advice.
- [Loopholes — legal wealth strategies](https://luxucleen.com/loopholes/): The real, legal moves the wealthy use — a trust or LLC that owns your assets, getting paid through a business, the tax-code breaks most people never claim (depreciation, 1031, retirement accounts, QBI, hiring your kids), and generational-wealth tools. Educational only, not legal or tax advice; each is set up by a licensed CPA or attorney and Luxucleen connects you.
- [Business credit — the honest timeline](https://luxucleen.com/business-credit/): A free, plain-English guide debunking the "get $50k–$250k in 30 days from 4 websites" reels.
- [Credit repair — the honest way](https://luxucleen.com/credit-repair/): A free, plain-English guide to fixing your PERSONAL credit the legal way — dispute inaccurate/duplicate/unverifiable items free under the FCRA, escalate a sham investigation to the CFPB for free, and avoid the upfront-fee and "CPN" scams. Debunks the "the bureaus got sued, dispute everything, make money off it" reels: you cannot legally erase accurate debts, disputing everything backfires, and Luxucleen never charges up front. AI reads all three reports, finds the real errors, and drafts the dispute letters you send yourself. The mechanics are real (a D-U-N-S number, a PAYDEX score of 80, net-30 tradelines that report to Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, Equifax/SBFE) but the timeline is oversold — the honest window is 3–12 months, the "$250k" is an advertised vendor credit-limit range not cash funding, and real bank/SBA funding needs time-in-business, revenue, and often a personal guarantee. Includes the real do-it-yourself timeline and the red flags in the coaching pitches. Educational only, no upsell.
- [Affiliates](https://luxucleen.com/affiliates/): Promote what Luxucleen sells and earn a commission on each sale, paid automatically.
- [Luxucleen Books](https://luxucleen.com/books/): We build your book with AI; you publish it on Amazon KDP under your own name and keep 88%, Luxucleen keeps 12%.
- [Luxu — the money feed](https://luxucleen.com/luxu/): A social feed where every post is a real way to make money — Luxucleen's businesses, products and live wins in one place, each a tap from getting it. Businesses can advertise their own post in the feed.

## Shop
- [Luxucleen Jewelry](https://luxucleen.com/jewelry/): Real moissanite and lab-grown VVS stones — iced-out rings, tennis chains, cuban links and earrings — at the best price, shipped to your door. Described honestly: moissanite and lab-grown, not mined natural diamond unless stated. You can buy, resell at wholesale, earn as an affiliate, or invest in the house.
- [Store](https://luxucleen.com/store/): Everything Luxucleen sells, with the live price, in one list.
- [Universal Store](https://luxucleen.com/universal/): An all-in-one store you don't browse — you tell it what you want and it generates the result on demand. Three ways to get anything: buy it, send an AI agent to call the seller and arrange the deal, or The Magnet — products sourced below the Amazon price and dropshipped (if we can't beat Amazon on it, it isn't listed). Plus a digital-goods section with instant delivery. Not affiliated with Amazon.
- [Zoncarii](https://luxucleen.com/zoncarii/): Luxucleen's streetwear label — the SZ monogram in black and gold. Statement tees, embroidered snapbacks, and a hand-drawn gold-line graphic series (phoenix, jaguar, wolf, aztec). Shop the full collection at zoncarii.com.

## Taxes
- [AI does your taxes](https://luxucleen.com/taxes/): AI prepares your yearly taxes cheaper than TurboTax, no upsells or hidden fees, built for people who run a business; a licensed preparer reviews and files it.

## Free AI tools
- [Ask Bridge28](https://luxucleen.com/ask/): A free AI assistant that answers questions and shows how Luxucleen would build and run your business idea.
- [Launchpad](https://luxucleen.com/launchpad/): Type one sentence and the AI builds and publishes a real, shareable business page in seconds. Free.
- [Free code vulnerability scanner](https://luxucleen.com/security/): Paste your code and the AI finds the security holes and the exact fixes, free, no install. Every Luxucleen product passes it before launch.
- [Explorer](https://luxucleen.com/explorer/): Paste a GitHub URL and get a visual map of the whole repository, an AI-ready digest of the code you copy in one click, and an in-browser file browser. Free, no install, no sign-up; runs entirely in your browser.
- [Clipp](https://luxucleen.com/clipp/): Paste a long-form transcript (podcast, livestream, YouTube, talk) and Clipp finds the most clip-worthy moments — the hooks, turns and punchlines that stop a scroll — with why each would perform and a drafted caption. The idea: AI can cut video easily now, but it doesn't know WHICH moment to clip; Clipp is that content-intelligence layer. Reads only your OWN content (never scrapes others), runs in your browser, stores nothing. Free.
- [tv28Live](https://luxucleen.com/tv28live/): Free live TV to watch together over one link, with a shared chat.
- Luxu voice concierge: a free voice assistant on every page — say its name or tap the orb, and it guides you to the right product and can speak back.
